Exploratory Data Analysis - Machine Learning Recommendation Models¶

import pandas as pd
pd.set_option('display.max_columns', None)

OMAI_mlrmeda = pd.read_csv('OMAI - Data - Machine Learning Recommendation Models (MLRMs).csv')
OMAI_mlrmeda = OMAI_mlrmeda.drop('Unnamed: 0', axis = 1)
OMAI_mlrmeda.iloc[0:1]
In [ ]:
import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

plt.rcParams['font.family'] = 'Times New Roman'
OMAI_mlrmeda_data1 = OMAI_mlrmeda[['average_bert_pred_prob_nonpos', 'average_bert_pred_prob_pos']]

plt.figure(figsize = (6, 4))
sns.violinplot(data = OMAI_mlrmeda_data1, palette = ['palevioletred', 'lightblue'])

plt.xticks([0, 1], ['Non-Positive', 'Positive'])

plt.title('Average DistilBERT Probability Distribution (Violin Plot)', fontsize = 12, fontweight = 'bold')
plt.xlabel('DistilBERT Prediction Type', fontsize = 10, fontweight = 'bold')
plt.ylabel('Average DistilBERT Probability', fontsize = 10, fontweight = 'bold')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

In [ ]:
import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

plt.rcParams['font.family'] = 'Times New Roman'

average_nonpos_probs = OMAI_mlrmeda['average_bert_pred_prob_nonpos']
average_pos_probs = OMAI_mlrmeda['average_bert_pred_prob_pos']

plt.figure(figsize = (6, 4))
sns.kdeplot(average_nonpos_probs, fill = True, color = 'palevioletred', label = 'Non-Positive', linewidth = 2)
sns.kdeplot(average_pos_probs, fill = True, color = 'lightblue', label = 'Positive', linewidth = 2)

plt.title('Average DistilBERT Probability Distribution (KDE Plot)', 
          fontsize = 12, fontweight = 'bold')
plt.xlabel('Average DistilBERT Probability', fontsize = 10, fontweight = 'bold')
plt.ylabel('Density', fontsize = 10, fontweight = 'bold')

plt.legend(title = 'DistilBERT Prediction Type', loc = 'center left', 
           bbox_to_anchor = (1.02, 0.5), frameon = True)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

import pandas as pd
from statsmodels.stats.outliers_influence import variance_inflation_factor

vif = OMAI_mlrmeda[['price', 'average_score', 'average_bert_pred_prob_pos', 'average_bert_pred_prob_nonpos', 
                    'average_sentiment_vader', 'review_counts']]

vif_data = pd.DataFrame()
vif_data["feature"] = vif.columns

vif_data["VIF"] = [variance_inflation_factor(vif.values, i) 
                   for i in range(vif.shape[1])]

print(vif_data)

                         feature        VIF
0                          price   3.145304
1                  average_score  71.061640
2     average_bert_pred_prob_pos  51.434852
3  average_bert_pred_prob_nonpos   6.232220
4        average_sentiment_vader   7.811988
5                  review_counts   1.622327

from statsmodels.stats.outliers_influence import variance_inflation_factor

vif_adjusted = OMAI_mlrmeda[['price', 'adjusted_average_score', 'adjusted_average_bert_pred_prob_pos', 
                           'adjusted_average_bert_pred_prob_nonpos', 'adjusted_average_sentiment_vader', 'review_counts']]

vif_data_adjusted = pd.DataFrame()
vif_data_adjusted["feature"] = vif_adjusted.columns

import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

plt.rcParams['font.family'] = 'Times New Roman'

price = OMAI_mlrmeda['price']
review_counts = OMAI_mlrmeda['review_counts']

sns.set_palette("deep")
sns.scatterplot(x = "price", y = "review_counts", 
                data = OMAI_mlrmeda, hue = "console", palette = "deep")

plt.title('Price & Review Counts Correlation per Console (Scatter Plot)', 
          fontsize = 12, fontweight = 'bold')
plt.xlabel('Price', fontsize = 10, fontweight = 'bold')
plt.ylabel('Review Counts', fontsize = 10, fontweight = 'bold')

plt.legend(title = 'Console', loc = 'center left', 
           bbox_to_anchor = (1.02, 0.5), frameon = True)

plt.show()

import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

plt.rcParams['font.family'] = 'Times New Roman'

sentiment_palette = {"Positive" : "deepskyblue", "Non-Positive" : "palevioletred"}

sns.scatterplot(x = "price", y = "review_counts", 
                data = OMAI_mlrmeda, hue = "adjusted_average_sentiment_label", palette = sentiment_palette)

plt.title('Price & Review Counts Correlation per Sentiment Label (Scatter Plot)', 
          fontsize = 12, fontweight = 'bold')
plt.xlabel('Price', fontsize = 10, fontweight = 'bold')
plt.ylabel('Review Counts', fontsize = 10, fontweight = 'bold')

plt.legend(title = 'Sentiment Label', loc = 'center left', 
           bbox_to_anchor = (1.02, 0.5), frameon = True)

plt.show()
